[[File:Uvak_stables.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Uvak stables at Eorm]]
The '''Uvak stables''' at [[Eorm]] were used to house the town's entire herd of [[uvak]]s, large winged reptiles that were used for transportation on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[2974 BBY]], [[the Doomed]] leader [[Kaliska (S'kytri)|Kaliska]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] princess [[Takara Hilts]] used the [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] [[Animal bond|animal friendship]] to convince all of the uvaks at that stable to fly them back to [[Eshkrene]]. This action effectively deprived the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Remulus Dreypa]] of an "air force" and provided the Doomed with beasts of steed which enabled them to participate in the [[Battle of Sessal Spire]].
